summary: Targeted retest of hamburger menu close fix only (frontend, desktop 1920x1080). localStorage cleared, page reloaded. Verified: (1) hamburger-btn opens menu and hamburger-menu renders; (2) document.elementFromPoint at hamburger-btn center returns an element contained by the button (svg path), i.e. the 'relative z-50' class now stacks the button above the z-30 backdrop; (3) second click on hamburger-btn (X icon) closed the menu with a NORMAL Playwright click (no force, no pointer-event timeout) and hamburger-menu detached; (4) regression check - backdrop click outside still closes the menu. No console errors, no error elements on page.

issues: All product cards use the same generic warehouse-shelf image; not representative of TMT/Cement/Sand/Bricks (pre-existing, cosmetic, not part of this fix)

critical_code_review_comments: Fix at /app/frontend/src/App.js line 187 ('relative z-50' on hamburger-btn) is correct and verified; button now sits above the fixed z-30 backdrop while backdrop still handles outside clicks
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hamburger open/close toggle bug from iteration_4 is RESOLVED and verified on desktop. Only remaining cosmetic note: duplicate/generic product images. Broader app flows (cart, orders, login OTP, admin, EMI, predictor) were validated in iterations 1-4 and were not re-run in this iteration.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously the menu backdrop (fixed inset-0 z-30) painted above the hamburger button because the button had no z-index in the same stacking context, so Playwright's actionability check found the backdrop at the click point and timed out. Adding 'relative z-50' to the button raises it above the backdrop; verified via elementFromPoint and a real (non-forced) click.
